reviews.author: Anoop Ravi
reviews.text:
We’ve had a wonderful experience with Ganga Dance Company. My daughter joined their Bollywood dance classes, and the growth we’ve seen in her skills and confidence has been truly impressive. One of the proudest moments for us was watching her perform a Bollywood routine at Global Village, the way she handled the stage with confidence was amazing to see.

A heartfelt thanks to Hemant Sir and Mayur Sir for their dedication, encouragement, and supportive teaching style. They create a positive and energetic environment where children not only learn dance but also gain self-confidence and stage presence. I highly recommend Ganga Dance Company to parents looking for professional and inspiring dance training for their kids.

Outstanding Dance Training at Ganga Dance Company with Hemant Gorkha!

I cannot express enough gratitude for the incredible experience my daughter has had at Ganga Dance Company. From the moment we enrolled her, we knew we had made the right choice. The studio offers a vibrant, supportive, and inspiring environment where students are encouraged to express themselves through dance while developing discipline and confidence.

A special mention to her dance instructor, Hemant Gorkha, whose dedication and passion for teaching are truly remarkable. He has a unique ability to connect with students, making learning both enjoyable and challenging. His patience, technique, and personalized approach have significantly improved my daughter’s skills and confidence in dance. Whether it’s classical, contemporary, or freestyle, Hemant ensures that each student gets the attention they need to grow as a dancer.

The professionalism, energy, and warmth at Ganga Dance Company make it an exceptional place to learn. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for top-quality dance training. Thank you, Hemant Gorkha, for your unwavering support and guidance—you are a fantastic mentor!
